scope: Type9 PHY pad impedance calibration; distinct from LPDDR4 DRAM-device ZQ commands and CA/DQS training
runtime_scope: Standalone explicit-call observation and timed experimental trigger only; not integrated into normal boot and not a calibration-success implementation

primary_sources.context: Retention restoration with previously trained CSRs and saved impedance codes. This is not a cold-boot implementation.

primary_sources.finding: Saves PU/PD calibration words by reading logical CSR 0x20326/0x20327 after training.
Independent host-register comments name 0x20310 ZCalReset and 0x20311 ZCalRun. No executable table, trained-CSR array or PIE program was imported or translated.

nxp_logical_csr_contract.fact: 0 enables host APB access; 1 releases access in the inspected retention path.
3 enables Hclk and Ucclk; 2 disables Ucclk while retaining Hclk in the inspected path.

nxp_logical_csr_contract.name: ZQCalCodeOvrPU
nxp_logical_csr_contract.fact: bit0 override enable; bits7:1 reserved zero; bits15:8 pull-up impedance code. OEI saves the full read word; SM restores (saved & 0xff00) | 1, then clears override.

nxp_logical_csr_contract.name: ZQCalCodeOvrPD
nxp_logical_csr_contract.fact: bit0 override enable; bits7:1 reserved zero; bits15:8 pull-down impedance code. OEI saves the full read word; SM restores (saved & 0xff00) | 1, then clears override.

nxp_logical_csr_contract.name: ZCalReset
nxp_logical_csr_contract.fact: 1 forces impedance calibration FSM idle; 0 releases reset.

nxp_logical_csr_contract.name: ZCalRun
nxp_logical_csr_contract.fact: Write 1 triggers impedance calibration sequence. Pulse/level and self-clearing semantics are not specified.

nxp_logical_csr_contract.name: PwrOkDlyCtrl in NXP comment
nxp_logical_csr_contract.fact: Set to 1 before starting calibration in the retention path. SiMa names this PorControl; do not infer a complete bitfield definition.

nxp_logical_csr_contract.name: PState
nxp_logical_csr_contract.fact: Select state matching DfiClk; NXP retention path uses state 0.

nxp_logical_csr_contract.name: ZcalDfiClkTicksPer1uS_p0
nxp_logical_csr_contract.fact: bits10:0 count DfiClk cycles per microsecond; NXP retention path updates this when NumPState > 2. Its ceil(pstate_freq[0]/8) expression is platform-specific and is not a T736 clock formula.

completion_evidence.interpretation: NXP waits a fixed 35 microseconds after triggering a retention calibration. It does not poll status, check new codes, or report a calibration error. This establishes a public timed host sequence, not verified T736 cold calibration or a bounded success/failure contract.

diagnostic_component.default: No automatic execution or normal-boot integration; caller first uses the separate read-only observation API.
diagnostic_component.observation_return: Positive OBSERVED_ONLY=1, only confirms completion of diagnostic register reads.
diagnostic_component.trigger_return: Positive TIMED_ONLY=2, only confirms the callback sequence and requested wait completed.
diagnostic_component.reset_hold_basis: Locally chosen minimum hold for a controlled diagnostic, not a documented target minimum pulse width.
diagnostic_component.run_deassert_basis: Public InfernoEmbedded LP5 pmu_clock.c::pmu_phy_clk_phase_toggle_pulse deasserts the matching ARC run register after its wait. This is an experiment boundary step, never cleanup after a failed operation.
preconditions: Explicit clock and analog-setup review acknowledgement
Timed trigger additionally requires NXP Hclk/Ucclk candidate value 3, reset value 0 or 1, run value 0, and PU/PD overrides disabled
diagnostic_component.failures: Stop at first failing callback, no retry or cleanup writes. Report attempted/completed writes separately because an error callback may already have affected hardware. Caller must use the controlled power-cycle path before another experiment.

t736_address_candidates.mapping_evidence_limit: The SDK directly corroborates adjacent MASTER-region halfword addresses, not these four exact CSR identities. Public A733 host source independently defines PHY APB base 0x0a900000; NXP provides the logical CSR identities and the public A733 ARC helper provides matching local byte offsets for reset/run. This is sufficient to formulate an explicitly reviewed experiment, not to claim T736 register semantics are proved.

public_a733_host_source.fact: Line96 defines SUNXI_DRAM_PHY_APB_BASE=0x0a900000. No firmware/PIE/init table content from this file was imported.

t736_address_candidates.cross_check: Public InfernoEmbedded LP5 pmu_clock.c::pmu_phy_clk_phase_toggle_pulse writes ARC 0x90040620=1, then 0, then 0x90040622=1, waits, and writes 0x90040622=0. NXP names suggest this helper is impedance calibration despite its phase/PLL comment. This is address/sequence corroboration, not LP4 compatibility proof.
t736_address_candidates.delay_warning: The LP5 helper passes 0x07bfa480 to a scaled delay helper. Its name does not make the argument an ordinary microsecond count; it was not used to derive a T736 wait.

facts: C_initPhyConfig uses STRH accesses to host calibration-region registers 0x0a940600, 0x0a940602, 0x0a940604, 0x0a940606, 0x0a940616 and 0x0a940650. Their full bitfields are not established.
Limited direct-literal/host-code inspection did not independently identify ZCalReset/Run or PU/PD result accesses. This is not an exhaustive proof that no computed access exists.
No PMU IMEM, private DMEM command table or PIE program was decoded, imported, translated or used as a runtime implementation.

older_phy_sources_not_transplanted.fact: Older layout: CalRate=0x88 (CalRun bit4, CalOnce bit5), CalZap=0x89 bit0, CalBusy=0x97 bit0. These are not corroborated Type9 offsets and must not be substituted for missing Type9 completion status.
Public older PHY register definitions and host calibration configuration do not close the Type9 ZCal status contract; no fields transplanted.

remaining_requirements: Corroborate the T736 PHY revision, logical CSR mapping and reset/run/result semantics independently of a vendor executable payload.
Establish cold-state clock/power/reset prerequisites and required analog configuration, including DfiClk ticks, resistor/range selection and result-latch control.

Define either a documented completion/error/freshness protocol or a target-specific worst-case timed completion contract with electrical-result validation; fixed waiting alone must not return verified success.
Establish safe abort/reset handling and exclusive SRAM execution with no live DRAM access during calibration.
Validate cold-source initialization and independently measured memory/training margins before integrating a normal-boot image.
